EQ et EQ paramétrique, suppresseur de ré: EQ and parametric EQ, resonance suppressor, 1176- and LA-2A-style compressors, multiband, de-esser, plosives and saturation: the whole vocal chain in one window, in the order you choose.
Mode MIX pour le mixage, avec une latenc: MIX mode for mixing, with a latency of about 44 ms compensated by your DAW. LIVE mode to record yourself through the plugin, with no latency.
Factory and user presets. VST3 and standalone, for 64-bit Windows.
Ta voix traitée en direct, en micro virt: Your voice processed live, as a virtual microphone for Discord, OBS and your games.
Broadcast est un mélangeur audio virtuel: Broadcast is a virtual audio mixer for Windows that lets you manage, mix and route several sound sources at once.
Correction et édition de la hauteur d'un: Pitch correction and editing of a voice, note by note.
PitchBox analyse une prise de voix, la d: PitchBox analyses a vocal take, cuts it into notes and lets you correct its pitch in one move or by hand: each note can be moved, snapped to a scale, or left as it was sung.
Correction automatique par gamme, avec d: Automatic correction by scale, with key detection (DETECT KEY), AMOUNT for the strength of the correction and SPEED for the transition from one note to the next. Note by note: the pitch, the MODULATION (how much of the vibrato and sung movement is kept), the volume, and FORMANT to shift the timbre without changing the pitch.
Dans un DAW compatible ARA 2 (Studio One: In an ARA 2-compatible DAW (Studio One, Logic Pro, Cubase, Nuendo, REAPER, Cakewalk), the take arrives in the plugin by itself. In the others (FL Studio, Ableton Live…), TRANSFER mode records it as it plays; you can also drag the vocal file onto the window.
Écoute d'une note en la maintenant, lect: Hold a note to hear it, playback and looping from the plugin, multiple selection, undo / redo, export of the notes as MIDI. A change is heard right away, without re-rendering the take.
Pensé pour une voix seule (une note à la: Designed for a single voice (one note at a time).
VST3 pour Windows ; VST3 et Audio Unit p: VST3 for Windows; VST3 and Audio Unit for Mac (Intel and Apple Silicon).
Suppresseur de résonances dynamique : il: Dynamic resonance suppressor: it softens what's harsh, without touching the rest.
ResoBox repère en temps réel les résonan: ResoBox spots in real time the resonances of a voice, an instrument or a whole mix — sibilance, harshness, notes that stick out — and attenuates them frequency by frequency, only when they are there.
Pour lui, une résonance est un endroit d: For it, a resonance is a spot in the spectrum that rises above what surrounds it on both sides. A slope, a plateau or the edge of a filtered signal are left alone: that's what sets it apart from a multiband compressor. It only acts on the level of each frequency, never on the phase.
DEPTH règle la quantité, DETAIL l'échell: DEPTH sets the amount, DETAIL the scale of the work (broad bumps or precise whistles), SOFT / HARD the character, ATTACK and RELEASE the speed, TILT tilts the processing towards the lows or the highs.
Sur l'écran, une courbe de sensibilité d: On screen, a sensitivity curve says where to work harder and where to spare: low cut, high cut and up to eight bands (bell, low shelf, high shelf, plateau), each able to act on the whole stereo image, the left, the right, the centre or the sides. The input spectrum, the output spectrum and the current reduction are shown live.
Modes stéréo, mid/side et mono avec LINK: Stereo, mid/side and mono modes with LINK and BALANCE, sidechain input, MIX, AUTO GAIN to restore the level, DELTA to hear only what is removed. Three quality settings and a LOW LATENCY mode; latency is reported to the DAW.
Neuf presets d'usine, presets personnels: Nine factory presets, personal presets, A/B comparison, and a description of each control when you hover over it.
RAW : wavetable, ASCII, et une grille de: RAW: wavetable, ASCII, and a grid of cells that decides the sound. ONIRIQUE X ABRASION
RAW, c’est un synthé wavetable à deux os: RAW is a two-oscillator wavetable synth that breathes like an organism rather than a machine: instead of a classic LFO, a Conway's Game of Life grid — born with every note played, living and dying by its own rules — drives the modulation. Two wavetable oscillators, a filter, an envelope, ten effects (distortion, flanger, phaser, chorus, delay, compressor, EQ, reverb...), and an interface entirely in ASCII — scope, spectrum, envelope, everything is drawn in characters, nothing in images.
La modulation n’est pas programmée, elle: Modulation isn't programmed, it emerges. On most synths, an LFO does exactly what it's told, in a loop. On RAW, the cell modulating your cutoff or your wavetable position can die of loneliness or multiply depending on how many neighbours are alive — same preset, same note, the movement is never identical to the previous hit. Every note redraws the grid. Playing isn't just triggering a sound, it's sowing new cells in the automaton — the instrument keeps a visual and sonic memory of what you just played. Zero heavy dependencies. No JUCE, no third-party UI framework — CLAP and VST3 written by hand, an embedded HTML/JS interface rendered by a native WebView. It stays light, quick to load, and fully under abrasion's control rather than tied to a generic framework's choices. The aesthetic is functional, not decorative. The ASCII isn't a retro skin: the scope, the spectrum, the wavetable and the life grid are literally the data shown as characters — you see the structure of the sound, not a skin on top of it.
Le Tamagotchi qui avale ta voix et la re: The Tamagotchi that swallows your voice and makes it bigger. ONIRIQUE X ABRASION
Un traitement vocal en forme de Tamagotc: Vocal processing shaped like a Tamagotchi: an egg swinging at the end of its chain, a little screen that reacts to your voice, and behind it all a real studio engine. You push the Flavor Drive knob, the voice feeds, the egg squashes.
Un écran qui sert d’indicateur. Le petit: A screen that works as a meter. The little character on the screen squashes when the compressor works, lights up when saturation rises, hisses on harsh “s” sounds and sleeps when the signal stops. You set it by eye as much as by ear. Three flavours of saturation. Pink (warm, tube-style), Blue (bold, 1176-style) and Black (aggressive, with wavefolding). An optical compressor that adapts. The release follows the voice, like an optical-cell compressor, and ten models inspired by the classics (1176, LA-2A and others) change its personality in one click. Attacks processed separately. Consonants and word onsets are split from the body of the voice: they keep their bite while the rest is compressed. Highs and sibilance tamed in one move. An automatic air shelf and de-esser add brightness without hardening the “s”. Constant volume. Auto-gain compensates the level, to compare the processed and original sound honestly. Zero latency in SNAP. Ideal for recording. PURE mode, more phase-accurate, is meant for mixing.
Doubleur de voix à cinq voix, avec pitch: Five-voice vocal doubler, with pitch and formant.
DoubleBox entoure une voix de quatre dou: DoubleBox surrounds a voice with four doubles, two on each side, as if it had been sung again. Each voice has its own place in the stereo field, its own delay, detune and level.
Sur la scène, les cinq voix se placent à: On the stage, the five voices are placed with the mouse: left to right is the stereo position, bottom to top the level. Delay up to 100 ms, detune up to ±50 cents, and multiple selection to adjust several voices at once.
PITCH et FORMANT (±12 demi-tons chacun): PITCH and FORMANT (±12 semitones each) apply to the voices of your choice: pitch changes the note while keeping the vowel, formant changes the vowel while keeping the note. DRIFT makes the doubles wander in pitch and time, each at its own pace, like a real second take.
MANIPULATE est un manipulateur de voix c: MANIPULATE is a complete voice manipulator, also for the voices of your choice. Timbre: HARMONICS slides the harmonics without changing the note (SNAP for whole harmonics), FM adds grit then a robotic edge, ALTERNATOR goes down to the octave below. Melody: RATIO goes from a voice that follows to a held note, OCTAVE shifts by octaves, GLIDE slides from one note to the next. Space: SMEAR melts attacks into a pad, STEREO widens, DETUNE detunes left and right. All dosed by its DRY / WET.
EQ grave / aigu sur l'ensemble ou sur le: Low / high EQ on everything or on the doubles only, overall level of the doubles, WIDTH, A/B comparison, and a preset browser with filters by origin and by sound type: doublers, transformed voices (low, high, robot, alien…), manipulated doubles, plus your own presets. The centre voice stays untouched unless you change it.
Pensé pour une voix seule. Latence de 28: Designed for a single voice. 28 ms latency, reported to the DAW.
Fait de la place à la voix dans un instr: Makes room for the voice in a finished instrumental.
Vocal Pocket : un EQ dynamique 20 bandes: Vocal Pocket: a 20-band dynamic EQ driven by your voice through the sidechain. It only carves the instrumental where the voice is masked, and only while it sings. The pocket follows phrases, not syllables: no pumping. Without a sidechain, STATIC mode applies a fixed voice-shaped pocket.
Space règle la largeur stéréo, ramène le: Space sets the stereo width, brings the lows to the centre and makes the sides shine. Restore gives punch back to the kick and energy to the mids. Auto Gain keeps the perceived loudness constant so you compare the sound, not the level.
Aucune latence. Presets d'usine et prese: No latency. Factory and user presets. VST3 and standalone for Windows, VST3 and Audio Unit for Mac.
Flanger, chorus et vibrato : du numériqu: Flanger, chorus and vibrato: from the cleanest digital to a lo-fi analogue circuit.
ModBox est un effet de modulation constr: ModBox is a modulation effect built around a delay line: flanger, chorus, dimension, vibrato. A single line, from one to eight voices, going from a barely noticeable effect to a wall of sound.
CIRCUIT fait passer la ligne du numériqu: CIRCUIT takes the line from perfect digital — no noise, flat response — to an analogue BBD circuit, with its filter, its saturation (DRIVE), its clock drift (DRIFT), its hiss (NOISE) and its number of stages (STAGES, from 256 to 4096).
DENSITY : VOICES empile jusqu'à huit voi: DENSITY: VOICES stacks up to eight voices, SPREAD spreads their delays, BASS KEEP leaves the low end untouched below the chosen frequency.
MODULATION : RATE et DEPTH règlent le ba: MODULATION: RATE and DEPTH set the sweep, STEREO offsets the right from the left (from 0 to 180°), a second LFO (RATE 2, LFO 2) breaks up the regularity, SHAPE picks sine or triangle.
INTENSITY : DELAY de 0,3 à 50 ms, FEEDBA: INTENSITY: DELAY from 0.3 to 50 ms, positive FEEDBACK (metallic) or negative (hollow, liquid), CROSS sends the feedback from one side to the other, MIX doses the effect.
AUTO GAIN ramène la sortie au niveau de: AUTO GAIN brings the output back to the input level (up to 12 dB either way), to judge a setting without being fooled by volume; OUT sets the final level.
TEXTURE salit les voix sans toucher au s: TEXTURE dirties the voices without touching the direct sound: CRUSH (down to 3 bits), DOWNSAMPLE (down to 300 Hz) and DISTORTION.
L'écran montre en direct ce que l'effet: The screen shows live what the effect does to the spectrum, left and right, and each voice's delay.
Presets d'usine et personnels, avec un n: Factory and personal presets, with a browser that sorts them by type (Flanger, Chorus, Vibrato, Bit Crusher, Distortion) and a search by name, A/B comparison, and a description of each control when you hover over it.
Entrée mono ou stéréo, sortie stéréo, au: Mono or stereo input, stereo output, no latency.
Synthé parasite : il vole le timbre et l: A parasite synth: it steals the timbre and movement of another sound.
MIMIC est un synthé qui se nourrit d'un: MIMIC is a synth that feeds on another sound. You play it notes over MIDI; it takes the timbre and dynamics of whatever you give it to devour — your DAW's sidechain (a voice, drums, a texture) or an audio file dropped straight into its maw.
MORPH imprime les formants de la source: MORPH prints the source's formants onto the oscillators: the synth speaks, hits or breathes like it. CARVE does the opposite, carving the source's dominant frequencies out of the synth to make room for it (down to −24 dB). GROOVE makes the synth follow the source's dynamics, on volume and filter opening.
DRY/WET va du synthé brut au synthé tran: DRY/WET goes from the raw synth to the transformed synth, BLEND from the base sound to the synth alone, OUTPUT sets the level; the output never exceeds 0 dB.
Trois lectures de la source : VOIX (form: Three readings of the source: VOIX (fine formants), PERCU (broad, reactive envelope), TEXTURE (slow detail). Four waveforms: saw, square, triangle, sine. 16 voices.
LOCK / FREEZE fige le timbre capturé : i: LOCK / FREEZE freezes the captured timbre: it becomes a wavetable you can play without the source.
Un fichier WAV, FLAC ou MP3 déposé dans: A WAV, FLAC or MP3 file dropped into the maw replaces the sidechain: each note retriggers it, transposed to the note played without changing its length.
L'écran montre en direct le timbre de la: The screen shows live the source's timbre and what the synth does with it; input and output meters, clip light.
Instrument avec entrée sidechain. VST3 p: Instrument with sidechain input. VST3 for Windows; VST3 and Audio Unit for Mac (Intel and Apple Silicon).
Le compteur de fin de master : loudness,: The end-of-master meter: loudness, spectrum and tonal balance, waveform and phase in a single window.
MeterBox se pose en dernier sur le maste: MeterBox sits last on the master and shows everything you need to check before exporting, in pictures as much as in numbers. It doesn't touch the sound: what comes out is what went in, with no latency.
LOUDNESS, mesuré selon ITU-R BS.1770-4 e: LOUDNESS, measured to ITU-R BS.1770-4 and EBU R 128: the integrated level in large type, with its distance from the target; the true peak on each side, momentary, short-term and integrated loudness as bars on a single scale; loudness range (LRA), PLR and PSR.
HISTORY trace le loudness dans le temps: HISTORY plots loudness over time — momentary, short-term, integrated — against the target, marks every true peak ceiling overshoot, and shows alongside the time spent at each level. Displayed span: 30 s, 2 min, 10 min or the whole track.
SPECTRUM affiche le spectre par tiers d': SPECTRUM shows the third-octave spectrum, instantaneous and averaged (3 s, 10 s or the whole track), with a target band on top: the spectral shape of a finished track. The average turns red where it leaves the band, and the deviation is summed up in four zones, from low to high. Four built-in targets (Modern, Urban, Rock, Acoustic), and CAPTURE to make one from your own reference track.
WAVEFORM déroule la forme d'onde de tout: WAVEFORM scrolls the waveform of everything measured, left and right, peaks and RMS level: the overview of the track.
PHASE : un goniomètre, la corrélation av: PHASE: a goniometer, correlation with its recent minimum, balance, width, what the mix loses in mono, and frequency-by-frequency correlation, to spot an out-of-phase low end at a glance.
Une norme règle la cible et le plafond d: A standard sets the target and the ceiling at once — Streaming -14 (Spotify, YouTube, Tidal, Amazon Music), Apple Music -16, Loud master -9, EBU R 128 -23, ATSC A/85 -24 — and both can also be set by hand. SYNC restarts the measurement on every playback and freezes it when stopped; PAUSE and RESET do the rest. During an export, the whole file is measured.
La description de chaque partie s'affich: Each part's description appears when you hover over it. Resizable window.
Mono or stereo input and output.
